description: CREATE a Robinhood Chain first-touch subscription (POST — this writes and consumes quota). Pushes on the rhc:kol:first_touches WS channel and/or an HMAC-signed webhook the moment a token gets its first tracked-KOL buy. FILTER SET DIFFERS FROM SOLANA ON PURPOSE: RHC has no scout-score table, so min_scout_tier and min_n_touches do NOT exist here (a filter that silently matched nothing would be worse than its absence); the RHC quality gates are min_kol_winrate and strategy. Unknown filter keys are REJECTED, not ignored. webhook_secret is returned EXACTLY ONCE. Quota is PER CHAIN (ULTRA 10, BUSINESS 50); exceeding it returns 409. Tier: ULTRA+.

filters.description: Filter object. Omit or {} to receive every first touch. Unknown keys are rejected

kol.description: Only first touches by this KOL EVM wallet (0x, 40 hex). Lowercased on write

max_mc_usd.description: Maximum token market cap — must be >= min_mc_usd

min_first_buy_eth.description: Minimum size of the first buy in ETH

min_kol_winrate.description: Minimum KOL 7d win-rate (0-1) — an RHC-only quality gate

min_mc_usd.description: Minimum token market cap at the first touch

strategy.description: Only KOLs classified with this trading strategy

webhook_url.description: HTTPS URL — REQUIRED unless delivery_mode is 'websocket'

name: rhc_first_touch_subscriptions_create
